description: This file implements ASN.1 string handling functions, including setting string masks, retrieving string tables, and managing ASN.1 string constraints based on OID identifiers. It defines functions for setting ASN.1 strings by NID, manages a standard string table, and provides testing access.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_set_default_mask
methods.description: Sets the default mask for ASN.1 string types (empty implementation).

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_get_default_mask
methods.description: Returns the default mask for ASN.1 string types, defaulting to UTF8.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_set_default_mask_asc
methods.description: Sets the default mask from an ASCII string (stub implementation).

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_set_by_NID
methods.description: Creates or sets an ASN1_STRING based on a NID, applying constraints from a string table.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_TABLE_add
methods.description: Adds a new ASN1_STRING_TABLE entry with constraints for a specific NID.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_TABLE_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the ASN1 string table (empty implementation).

methods.name: asn1_get_string_table_for_testing
methods.description: Provides access to the standard ASN1 string table for testing purposes.
